extraction_notes: The supplied PDF SHA-256 was verified as b47cf9fe06d5c2e0e322b46fb95a753e1398a40b5bb7eb52a70b2f4423cb1956; the supplied identity is LCSC C18199105, MPN S5MB, manufacturer hongjiacheng.

The datasheet identity is S5AB THRU S5MB SURFACE MOUNT GENERAL PURPOSE RECTIFIER, Rev:1.1, three pages; the exact S5MB column and all three pages were examined. The visible manufacturer is Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd.

Fig. 3 is a grouped typical forward-voltage curve for S5AB-S5MB at Tj = 25 degC, pulse width = 300 us, and 1% duty cycle. The ten points are direct observations from the supplied plot at visible voltage positions from 0.2 V through 1.1 V; no intermediate points were synthesized or interpolated.

Fig. 4 is a grouped typical reverse-characteristics plot for S5AB-S5MB. The seven points on each Tj curve are direct observations at 10%, 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%, and 120% of rated peak reverse voltage; reverse current is represented as the positive magnitude shown on the microampere logarithmic axis, with no intermediate points synthesized or interpolated.

The S5MB electrical-characteristics rows give maximum VF = 1.0 V at IF = 5.0 A, maximum IR1 = 2 microA at VR = VDC = 1000 V and Ta = 25 degC, separate maximum IR2 = 200 microA at VR = VDC and Ta = 125 degC, and typical CJ = 50 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz. SI conversions are used in specs: 2 microA = 2e-6 A and 50 pF = 5e-11 F.

Absolute maximum ratings for S5MB include VRRM = 1000 V, VRMS = 700 V, VDC = 1000 V, IF(AV) = 5.0 A, IFSM = 150 A at t = 8.3 ms half-sine wave, Tj = -55 to +150 degC, and storage temperature = -55 to +150 degC. These ratings are limits and are not treated as breakdown data.

The supplied datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time, breakdown-voltage, or breakdown-current specification. VRRM and VDC ratings, and the Fig. 4 curve knee above rated voltage, are not substituted for breakdown data.
